evidence_snippets: Example: Optimizer version (Click to expand) The following example shows how to execute queries using a specific optimizer version with the Spanner JDBC driver. -- Set the optimizer version to 5 and execute a query.
SET OPTIMIZER VERSION = '5' ; SELECT FirstName , LastName FROM Singers ORDER BY LastName ; -- Execute the same query with the latest optimizer version.
